title: Debugging Neural Networks
motto: Your network compiled. It ran. It produced a number. The number is wrong and nothing crashed. Welcome to the hardest kind of debugging -- the kind where there is no error message.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Your network compiled. It ran. It produced a number. The number is wrong and nothing crashed. Welcome to the hardest kind of debugging -- the kind where there is no error message.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Traditional software crashes when it is broken. A null pointer throws an exception. A type mismatch fails at compile time. An off-by-one error produces a clearly wrong output.
Neural networks do not give you that luxury.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: NaN loss = exploding grad or bad LR. Check for inf/nan in activations and gradients early.

steps.title: Implement debug
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
